source: data.police.uk Stop and Search API, latest 3 months published by each force (force coverage 36 of 45 forces in window). Self-defined ethnicity bucketed into broad groups.
caveat: Stop-and-search composition is NOT a crime-rate measure. The ethnicity mix shown is who was stopped, not who committed an offence. Disparity-ratio interpretation requires a population denominator by ethnicity per force area, which is not computed here. data.police.uk caps response sizes at 2,000 records per force-month; high-volume forces (Met, West Midlands) may truncate.
